title: REPORT on the implementation of the common security and defence policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 135. Recalls that terrorism, including extremist right-wing terrorism and jihadi terrorism, poses a persistent threat to the security of the EU and of its partners; calls on the EU to continue efforts to prevent this threat with determination and full solidarity, in particular through greater coordination to improve knowledge, develop preparedness and response capabilities, and to ensure closer interaction with partners and other international actors;
